component: POP3 selected body and stale partial cleanup

quotes.text:
/**
   * Check if DownloadMessagesForOffline() has stored a message header of
   * a partial message with the same message ID in mDownloadPartialMessages.
   * If so, remove the header from that array and return it.
   *
   * This method is only invoked by nsPop3Sink::IncorporateComplete.
   *
   * @param newHdr The message header to match.
   * @return If found, the message header of the partial message, else nullptr.
   */
  nsIMsgDBHdr retrieveHdrOfPartialMessage(in nsIMsgDBHdr newHdr);

  /**
   * Notify about deletion of partial messages not existing anymore on the server.
   *
   * This method is only invoked by nsPop3Sink::CheckPartialMessages.
   */
  void notifyDelete();

source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: 1528 exposed downloadInProgress and made FindPartialMessages/CheckPartialMessages return during selected-body downloads. That fixed the reported Leave Messages on Server interaction historically. Accepted nsIMsgLocalMailFolder no longer exposes the attribute, and the sink instead skips DiscardStalePartialMessages when m_uidlDownload is true at EndMailDelivery. Keep the safety condition, not the obsolete getter. Later d8142678a9c is a metadata-located refactor context only; its full diff/discussion is not counted here. This is static source evidence. No runtime, build, lint or live accessibility check was run. Full Bugzilla and Phabricator discussion remains pending.
title: Preserve the historical selected-POP-body purge lesson without reviving its removed API
